nodes.asset_description: A man wearing sunglasses and a gray jacket stands with his right hand raised, wearing a black glove on his left wrist. Behind him, a cityscape is visible at sunset, with buildings and a road extending into the distance. Orange and yellow tones are prominent in the sky and cityscape.
